rules.title: Measure BB: 5% cap on Annual General Adjustment for fully covered units
rules.requirement: For fully covered units, the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) set by the Rent Board using the CPI formula may not exceed 5%. Landlords with banked AGAs from earlier years may still raise rent by more than 5% to reach the rent ceiling.

exemption_conditions.condition: Units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord are exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
exemption_conditions.value: tenant shares kitchen or bath with landlord who lived on property at start of tenancy

exemption_conditions.condition: Partially covered units (e.g., new construction with certificate of occupancy issued after 1980, most single-family homes and condominiums) have no rent ceiling.

Units with Section 202, Section 811, or HUD-insured/held mortgage projects with Rent Supplement, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, or Project-based Section 8 subsidies are only partially covered because federal/state law or regulation prohibits rent control.
value: HUD-insured/held projects with Rent Supplement, Section 8 LMSA, or Project-based Section 8

coverage.notes: Applies to fully covered units, e.g., most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually. Government-owned or -subsidized units are now fully or partially covered depending on unit type.

rules.coverage_text: Fully covered rental units in Berkeley (units with a rent ceiling), including government-owned or -subsidized units that are fully covered depending on unit type.
rules.exemptions: Exempt units and partially covered units are not subject to the rent ceiling. Shared kitchen/bath units are exempt only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy. Certain subsidized units are partially covered only where federal law, state law, or administrative regulation prohibits rent control.

enacted_date.quoted_span: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election

rules.interaction: Subsidized units are only partially covered when Federal law, State law, or administrative regulation exempts them from the rent control provisions of the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.

rules.title: Measure BB: changes to just cause eviction grounds and notice requirements
rules.requirement: Tenants in fully or partially covered units may only be evicted for just cause; nonpayment evictions require rental debt of at least one month's HUD Fair Market Rent for an equivalent unit, and landlords may not evict for failure to sign a substantially similar new lease. Lease-violation evictions require a mutually agreed material term, substantial actual harm, unreasonable tenant behavior, and a detailed cure notice; termination notices must reference the Rent Board and be filed with it within three business days of service.
rules.key_value: Nonpayment eviction only if rental debt >= one month's Fair Market Rent

exemption_conditions.condition: Units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord are exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
exemption_conditions.value: tenant shares kitchen or bath with landlord who lived on property at start of tenancy

coverage.notes: Government-owned or -subsidized units (Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME, etc.) are now fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, now including government-owned or -subsidized units.
rules.exemptions: Units exempt from the Rent Ordinance; shared kitchen/bath units are exempt only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy.

enacted_date.quoted_span: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election

rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.

llm.notes: The document is an official Berkeley Rent Board guide to Measure BB's amendments to the Rent Ordinance. The guide gives no section numbers or effective dates for the extracted rules. The other changes it describes (utilities, notice of tenant rights, right to organize, tenancy reporting, fines, relocation adjustments) do not fall in the target categories and were not recorded.
